Updated the default donation split settings from 60% comptant / 40% scolaire to 100% comptant / 0% scolaire. Changes made in:

1. **CampaignCreator.jsx** — Initial state for new campaigns
2. **campaigns/create.js** — API fallback defaults when creating campaigns
3. **CampaignEditor.jsx** — Initial state and fallback when loading existing campaigns

All new campaigns created in the school dashboard will default to 100% comptant (studentCash) and 0% scolaire (studentAccount). No linting errors.
